text:
elaine-support: FYI customer (AcmeMaps) reports repeated timeouts and 5xxs from hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. They see spikes every ~2-3m for ~30s, affects their batch traffic. Link to customer ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-3124

mike-oncall: I'm on it — creating incident channel + paging runtime oncall. initial impression: gateway 502/504s with increased latency to backend. Paging @anna-eng-runtime and @jordan-obs.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026. Pager dispatched to: mike-oncall, sam-sre.

anna-eng-runtime: seeing a correlated surge in request queue depth on the eu-west model pool starting 09:11:35 UTC. KV-cache hit rate drops briefly when the waves start. Looks like frequent small bursts from the customer causing small batch blowups.

jordan-obs: Traces: https://obs.redwood.ai/trace/4912001111 — 95th p99 latency jumps coincide with upstream connection resets to model-host-12. I also see auth proxy retries in front of the gateway.

elaine-support: Customer attached a minimal repro curl, they hit /v1/generate with 30 concurrent connections and 2s request window: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_cust' -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b","prompt":"hi"}'``` They claim they didn't change client.

mike-oncall: Repro locally with small script — can replicate 503 wave when concurrent connections >24 for that endpoint and model in eu-west. Gateway circuit-breaker trips, fallback to 5xx. Running `netstat` shows many TIME_WAIT. I propose immediate mitigations: 1) raise CB throttle temporarily for that customer route, 2) enable model fallback to lower memory variant, 3) add short-term IP-level rate limit to smooth bursts. Thoughts?

sam-sre: +1 on smoothing. Also suggest enabling prefix KV-cache warmup for that model to reduce cold cache stalls. We should be careful raising CB without visibility — can cause downstream overload.

lisa-billing: Note: customer recently had a billing reconciliation that doubled their token throughput during their window due to a bug on their side (duplicate retries). We flagged overage but they continued. I'll add billing telemetry to the incident board.

anna-eng-runtime: Quick action: bumped model-host connection pool backoff (09:28 UTC) and enabled a soft-rate-limit for that route for 15m. Observed immediate reduction in 5xx spike amplitude. We rolled a canary to 10% of requests to fallback variant; no regressions.

jordan-obs: Metrics show p50 latency steady, p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 0.9s after the soft limit and fallback. KV-cache hit % recovered. Logs: a handful of auth proxy 401->retry patterns from the customer key, likely triggering retries; recommend investigating client retry logic.

ben-sales: Customer is on a paid SLO, they're in support call now and worried about production impact. Can we get a short summary for them and expected ETA to full mitigation?

mike-oncall: Draft summary: we observed short, high-frequency burst patterns from the customer's traffic causing queueing and CB trips at the gateway; mitigation applied: temporary soft-rate-limit, fallback variant canary, connection pool tweaks. Full mitigation plan: followup configuration to pin customer to dedicated queueing policy + request guidance to reduce client-side retries. ETA for stable config: 3-6h.

elaine-support: Sending that summary to the customer now and offering a joint call with platform if they want help debugging retries. They asked for postmortem and action items.

sam-sre: Action items agreed: 
- (AI-1) Runtime: add per-customer smoothing policy + circuit-breaker tuning for bursty-batch patterns (owner: anna-eng-runtime, ETA: 72h)
- (AI-2) Observability: add alert when KV-cache hit rate drops >15% and concurrent queue depth increases (owner: jordan-obs, ETA: 48h)
- (AI-3) Support: template to advise customers on safe retry windows and dedup (owner: elaine-support, ETA: 24h)
- (AI-4) Billing: detect billing anomalies that correlate with sudden throughput increases and auto-notify support (owner: lisa-billing, ETA: 7d)

mike-oncall: Also adding a short-term runbook snippet for oncall: how to enable per-route soft-rate-limit and safe rollback steps. I'll attach to the incident.

jordan-obs: Adding traces and grafana snapshots to the postmortem doc.

lisa-billing: Noted — I'll reach out to AcmeMaps about their retry bug and discuss potential credits if our guidance helps reduce impact.

ben-sales: Customer appreciated fast response, on the call now they want the postmortem. Please ping me when doc is ready so I can share.

elaine-support: Follow-up plan: postmortem doc (inc-2026) with timeline, root cause, and AI list. Tentative owners assigned. I'll update ticket and schedule a 90-min postmortem review tomorrow 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026 status -> mitigated at 09:35 UTC.

mike-oncall: Thanks team — keep updates short here. If anyone is blocked on action items flag now.

anna-eng-runtime: No blockers. I'll start on AI-1 and share design in eng-runtime channel.

elaine-support: closing thread for now, will reopen in incident doc for postmortem drafting.
